rows.name: Fairfax Financial
rows.blurb: Canadian insurance group that will hedge the book when the price of risk looks wrong — the discipline shows up in drawdowns.

rows.name: Berkshire Hathaway
rows.blurb: The reference point: insurance float, a private industrial book and a public equity portfolio run with decades of patience.

rows.name: Scion Asset Management
rows.blurb: Deep-value positions sized for asymmetric payoff, with public calls on bubbles and a willingness to sit in cash.

rows.name: Markel Group
rows.blurb: Insurance float reinvested in equities and whole businesses; the closest listed analogue to Berkshire.

rows.name: Duquesne Family Office
rows.blurb: Top-down macro married to concentrated growth equity; the record is built on position sizing as much as stock picking.

rows.name: Himalaya Capital
rows.blurb: Very few names, held for a decade or more, bridging US and Asian franchises.

rows.name: Pershing Square
rows.blurb: A handful of large-cap activist positions in a permanent-capital wrapper; high conviction, high tracking error.

rows.name: Valley Forge Capital
rows.blurb: Five to eight wide-moat compounders held for years. Concentration is the strategy, not a side effect.

rows.name: Baupost Group
rows.blurb: Absolute-return value investing with a permanent cash reserve — the 13F shows the long book, not the dry powder.

rows.name: Third Point
rows.blurb: Event-driven equity with an activist overlay; the long book turns over faster than the buy-and-hold names on this list.

metrics.label: Sharpe
metrics.description: Annualised excess return per unit of volatility.

metrics.label: Sortino
metrics.description: Excess return per unit of downside deviation.

metrics.label: Alpha
metrics.description: Annualised return not explained by the benchmark.

metrics.label: Annual return
metrics.description: Geometric annual return over the window.

metrics.label: Max drawdown
metrics.description: Worst peak-to-trough loss (less negative is better).

metrics.label: Calmar
metrics.description: Annual return divided by the maximum drawdown.

metrics.label: CVaR 95
metrics.description: Average loss on the worst 5% of days.

metrics.label: Beta
metrics.description: Sensitivity to the benchmark; lower is steadier.

metrics.label: Concentration
metrics.description: Largest position weight; lower is more diversified.
